text:
Riley Park: Quick triage  our DP invite funnel is underperforming. 60 invites sent, 4 completions. Need quick remediation ideas.
Nora Li: Saw the drop-offs. Two main signals: the form asks for estimated monthly spend (turns folks off) and the onboarding step for API keys has stale screenshots.
Evan Ortiz: Also getting report that Slack invite links are blocked by some corporate MX rules; click-throughs show `INVITE_REDIRECT_BLOCK` in logs.
Priya Shah: Can we run two parallel outreach paths: 'express try' (one-click, minimal questions) and 'commit DP' (detailed form + NDA)?
Riley Park: Yes — express try for discovery, DP path for true partners. We should change invite language per path.
Nora Li: For DP path acceptance criteria draft:
- 4 x 20-min feedback sessions across 30 days
- 2 labeled production prompts + usage context
- Signed NDA + data handling acknowledgement
Evan Ortiz: Suggest rewording feedback asks to be feature-scoped: e.g., "rate output relevance on 2 prompts" + "reproduce any errors with steps". Makes sessions actionable.
Priya Shah: I'll make the org-size & spend fields optional and move spend to a follow-up survey after activation.
OnboardBot: docs: onboarding v2.5 deployed to staging at 2025-06-05T09:42Z
Evan Ortiz: I'll add email fallback tokens for blocked domains and a one-click activation link. ETA EOD. Test cohort: `dp-express-2025-06-05`.
Riley Park: A/B plan: baseline invite vs short invite + $300 credits + early access badge. 2 x 100 recipients, measure week-1 activation.
Nora Li: Also add a short checklist in the invite: "what we need from you" with bullet points so DP ask is transparent.
Priya Shah: I'll update the invite copy and the initial form tonight and open PRs `forms/invite#77` + `docs/onboard#198`.
Evan Ortiz: Logged failing domains to infra ticket INF-412: corpworks.com, bigco.org. Sample log: `2025-06-05T08:11Z INVITE_REDIRECT_BLOCK corpworks.com`
Riley Park: Schedule 30m sync 15:00 PT today. Agenda: deploy fallback, finalize DP acceptance text, A/B plan. Bring any test telemetry.
Nora Li: Adding success metrics to tracker: activation %, onboarding completion, feedback session attendance, week-2 CSAT.
Priya Shah: Small ask: can we include a short template for feedback sessions to standardize notes? 5 bullet prompts max.
Evan Ortiz: I'll ship the fallback and paste initial open/click numbers before the sync.
Riley Park: OK team, objective: lift activation from ~6% -> 30% for express invites. Small experiments only. Ping me if blocked.
Nora Li: :thumbsup:
Priya Shah: On it.
Evan Ortiz: Will report back in this thread.
